d: BeerBiceps’ video on Vastu Shastra is what happens when you mix fancy studio lighting with unverified pseudoscience, and yet millions of people eagerly lap it up. Ranveer Allahbadia, known for hosting some of India’s greatest minds—from ISRO’s chairman to renowned artists—brings on Acharya Pankit Goyal to discuss the “science” of Vastu. What follows is a series of bizarre claims ranging from how the direction of your house can affect your behavior to why corner plots bring negative energy! Acharya ji even dips into geography, declaring the dominance of Gujarat and the ""West,"" seemingly…
